Robot documentation:
Robot: one Franka Panda arm with a parallel-jaw gripper in a tabletop simulation. The table surface is at world z=0.80 m. World +z points upward. All position targets and measured end-effector positions use the same world frame.

The move_to tool accepts absolute x, y, z, yaw, and gripper targets. Position units are meters and yaw units are radians. Gripper commands are binary: use 0 to close and 1 to open. The reported gripper value is the measured opening normalized from 0 to 1, so holding an object may produce an intermediate measurement. In the adapter, targets below 0.35 latch closed, targets above 0.65 latch open, and intermediate targets retain the previous command. Intermediate commanded openings are not supported. Cameras: front and side are fixed views; wrist moves with the hand. All are 224x224 RGB images with the top row at the top of the view. The wrist view can rotate as the hand rotates. No fixed mapping from image directions to world x/y is assumed. Each request includes the current three views and retains images from at most the two most recent observations.
